author: JstrJad
body:
Dear Mods and others,

Hello, I am JstrJad. I've been ban for fly hacking four months and 6 days ago. Like I have previously stated, I've gotten rid of any hacking and cheating mods and will no longer attempt rule breaking. I understand why I was banned and I thank you for fallowing the rules and teaching me to do the same. As I've also previously stated, this is my favorite server that I enjoy playing on. I ask that I may be given a second chance and prove myself worthy of play on Avicus.

Thank you!
 - JstrJad

title: Fly ban appeal

replies.author: rinn
replies.body:
Hello,

I have decided to accept your appeal and unban you from the server, as you have waited a significant amount of time as a banned user. However, if you are banned again, keep in mind that your chances of appealing again will be decreased. Please be sure to read the updated rules (http://avicus.net/rules), and welcome back to the server!
   
Regards,
Rinn
Avicus Network Senior Moderator
